sources.creator: Eric Rémy (artistic direction)
sources.researchNote: The FA 5033 discography dates the Polydor 522987 recording, matrix 1444 WPP, to 18 October 1934. The BnF catalogue dates a Lys Gauty performance with Wal Berg’s orchestra on the separate compilation Jean-Christophe Averty présente les Cinglés du Music-Hall: 1934 to 28 September 1934, but does not give a matrix number. The descriptions do not establish whether the two reissues use the same recording or take; the differing dates should not be treated as a resolved conflict.
